coverage.claim: Nonempty conforming cell-face meshes, face orientation, adjacency, anchoring, and explicit uniform-family geometry bounds.
Orthogonal center-normal TPFA for scalar positive cellwise diffusion, including exact series-resistance harmonic transmissibility and boundary fluxes.
Finite-volume shared-flux cancellation, weighted Green identity, boundary-anchored stiffness coercivity/uniqueness, and nonnegative-data minimum principle.
Discrete Poincare bound from supplied simple boundary paths with explicit finite congestion; uniformity is conditional on a uniform congestion bound.
TPFA numerical face-flux convergence in a transmissibility-dual energy norm for uniformly smooth, face-aligned coefficient interfaces and uniformly bounded Hessians.
Hybrid mimetic cell/face scheme on general polytopal cells with explicit face-moment closure, residual stabilization, anisotropic linear flux, and a candidate monotone p-growth time-step formula.
Local coercivity, global Dirichlet SPD/uniqueness, local conservation, affine exactness, and conditional nonlinear operator monotonicity/coercivity.

Conditional parabolic limit identification via weak formulation, derived evolution derivative and initial trace, and Minty, with conforming reconstruction, L-infinity(H), residual, compactness, and energy-limsup conditions explicit.
Exact affine flux and conservation on a two-cell rectangular Voronoi mesh.
Explicit nonorthogonal triangular-face counterexample where Euclidean two-point flux is transverse and nonzero while exact normal flux is zero.
Exact one-dimensional 1-to-9 diffusion-interface flux computed from half-cell resistances and compared with arithmetic averaging.
Exact anisotropic affine fluxes and residual-free mimetic reconstruction on a skew parallelogram.
A theorem deriving conforming W0^{1,p} reconstructions, finite-volume compactness/strong state convergence, vanishing weak residual, and the energy limsup for the defined nonlinear FV scheme.
coverage.reason: The PE12 suppliers prove compactness only for conforming FEM reconstructions or require discrete derivative control; they do not establish these hypotheses for this cell-and-face finite-volume family. This batch therefore proves the implication conditionally and records the missing scheme-specific bridge for owner placement.

coverage.claim: Unconditional nonlinear parabolic convergence of the stated hybrid mimetic family from mesh regularity and the scheme equations.
coverage.reason: The definition asserts no solvability or compactness, and the conditional Minty lemma assumes reconstruction, residual, weak-gradient, and energy limits. A separate finite-volume evolution theorem must establish each condition before unconditional convergence can be claimed.

coverage.claim: General-mesh mimetic convergence under a proved discrete compactness and limit-conformity theorem.
coverage.reason: The local proposition proves cell coercivity and affine consistency but does not compare its gradient-residual norm with a continuous Sobolev norm or prove compactness as the mesh is refined. Add a geometric discrete-compactness supplier before this convergence claim.

coverage.claim: Universal discrete maximum principle for anisotropic mimetic or general MPFA schemes.
coverage.reason: The local stabilized tensor form proves coercivity and affine flux exactness, not the off-diagonal sign conditions or irreducibility needed for positivity. The source review also warns against transferring a general maximum-principle claim.
